payload.title: Ethernet and ARP
payload.summary: Parse Ethernet II and Ethernet/IPv4 ARP safely, then construct an exact broadcast ARP request without using live networking.

prerequisites: Explicit big-endian 16-bit reads and writes from lesson 01 or equivalent experience
Arrays, memcpy, fixed-width integers, ordinary C structs, and checked capacities
outcomes: Parse Ethernet II headers and expose checked payload offsets and lengths
Validate Ethernet/IPv4 ARP descriptors before copying address fields
Build a complete broadcast ARP request atomically

payload.exercise: Complete the three TODO(lesson 02) regions in lessons/02_ethernet_arp/exercise.c.
checks: Use byte-wise big-endian helpers and publish parse outputs only after complete validation
Match the exact 42-octet request fixture and preserve payload offset and length
Leave failed parse outputs zeroed and failed build destinations unchanged

allowed: Deterministic in-memory frame parsing and construction
Explicit caller-owned address and destination spans
Portable byte operations without packed wire overlays
excluded: Live network access, raw sockets, capture, or external commands
Discovering real neighbors or transmitting frames
ARP cache poisoning or traffic monitoring
